model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant counts across several criteria. The horizontal axis displays the criteria labels: “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation” listed in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer values. Six individual bars are displayed, each representing a criterion; the bars are colored in shades of teal, green, light blue, dark blue, purple, and black. The “FC Summary” bar, colored black, extends to a value of 6, while the “Veracity Explanation” bar, colored teal, extends to a value of 1. The “Relevance Explanation” bar extends to a value of 2, the “Clarity and Simplicity” bar extends to a value of 3, the “Overall Summary” bar extends to a value of 5 while the “Filters” bar reaches a value of 3. The bars are arranged in ascending order of participant count with no visual emphasis applied to any of them.
